reproduction.runContract: run_probe verifies candidate hashes, backs up the protected data/metadata/version files, installs only those candidate files, starts the official launcher, waits boundedly for result/status, copies live diagnostics into the candidate directory, and restores the protected files. A successful live restore keeps the process; otherwise it closes the game and restores from backup. Before/after protected hashes must match or the run refuses success.
